front_blocks.md: Will the **vertex **of the graph $y=-x^{2}+x+5$ be a **maximum **or a **minimum **point?

back_blocks.md: The **vertex **of the graph $y=-x^{2}+x+5$ will be a **maximum **point.
The vertex of a quadratic graph will be a maximum point if the coefficient of $x^{2}$ is **negative**. The graph is n-shaped.
